high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post. The post features two dogs on a dock during sunset. The setting appears to be a serene waterfront with calm water reflecting the warm hues of the sunset. In the background, there are boats docked along the shore, and the sky is painted with shades of orange and yellow as the sun sets. The main focus of the image is on two dogs. One dog, which appears to be a golden retriever, is sitting on the dock with its head resting on the other dog's back. The other dog, possibly a puppy, is standing behind the golden retriever, hugging it affection
